title: SuperSlicer CLI adapter config
description: Configuration for SuperSlicer (PrusaSlicer fork with extra features). Safe probe uses --help only.

exe_path.description: Absolute path to superslicer-console.exe, superslicer, or SuperSlicer.

version.description: Detected version string from --help output, e.g. '1.3.9.52'.

cli_supported.description: True when SuperSlicer supports --help and --export-gcode CLI flags.
